1.w: By David. Do not fret when wicked men seem to succeed. Do not envy evildoers.

2.w: For they will quickly dry up like grass, and wither away like plants.

3.w: Trust in the Lord and do what is right. Settle in the land and maintain your integrity.

4.w: Then you will take delight in the Lord, and he will answer your prayers.

5.w: Commit your future to the Lord. Trust in him, and he will act on your behalf.

6.w: He will vindicate you in broad daylight, and publicly defend your just cause.

7.w: Wait patiently for the Lord! Wait confidently for him! Do not fret over the apparent success of a sinner, a man who carries out wicked schemes.

8.w: Do not be angry and frustrated. Do not fret. That only leads to trouble.

9.w: Wicked men will be wiped out, but those who rely on the Lord are the ones who will possess the land.

10.w: Evil men will soon disappear; you will stare at the spot where they once were, but they will be gone.

11.w: But the oppressed will possess the land and enjoy great prosperity.

12.w: Evil men plot against the godly and viciously attack them.

13.w: The Lord laughs in disgust at them, for he knows that their day is coming.

14.w: Evil men draw their swords and prepare their bows, to bring down the oppressed and needy, and to slaughter those who are godly.

15.w: Their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.

16.w: The little bit that a godly man owns is better than the wealth of many evil men,

17.w: for evil men will lose their power, but the Lord sustains the godly.

18.w: The Lord watches over the innocent day by day, and they possess a permanent inheritance.

19.w: They will not be ashamed when hard times come; when famine comes they will have enough to eat.

20.w: But evil men will die; the Lord’s enemies will be incinerated — they will go up in smoke.

21.w: Evil men borrow, but do not repay their debt, but the godly show compassion and are generous.

22.w: Surely those favored by the Lord will possess the land, but those rejected by him will be wiped out.

23.w: The Lord grants success to the one whose behavior he finds commendable.

24.w: Even if he trips, he will not fall headlong, for the Lord holds his hand.

25.w: I was once young, now I am old. I have never seen the godly abandoned, or their children forced to search for food.

26.w: All day long they show compassion and lend to others, and their children are blessed.

27.w: Turn away from evil. Do what is right. Then you will enjoy lasting security.

28.w: For the Lord promotes justice, and never abandons his faithful followers. They are permanently secure, but the children of the wicked are wiped out.

29.w: The godly will possess the land and will dwell in it permanently.

30.w: The godly speak wise words and promote justice.

31.w: The law of their God controls their thinking; their feet do not slip.

32.w: The wicked set an ambush for the godly and try to kill them.

33.w: But the Lord does not surrender the godly, or allow them to be condemned in a court of law.

34.w: Rely on the Lord. Obey his commands. Then he will permit you to possess the land; you will see the demise of the wicked.

35.w: I have seen ruthless, wicked people growing in influence, like a green tree grows in its native soil.

36.w: But then one passes by, and suddenly they have disappeared. I looked for them, but they could not be found.

37.w: Take note of the one who has integrity. Observe the upright. For the one who promotes peace has a future.

38.w: Sinful rebels are totally destroyed; the wicked have no future.

39.w: But the Lord delivers the godly; he protects them in times of trouble.

40.w: The Lord helps them and rescues them; he rescues them from the wicked and delivers them, for they seek his protection.
